data.action: 在茶具旁整理白蔷薇，回望微笑
data.description: 【圣园未花 · 帕特尔派议事厅的小憩】帕特尔派的华丽休息室内，未花将一枝刚采摘的白蔷薇插在红茶杯旁，双手托腮笑眯眯地凝视着批改文件的你——「唔～文件有什么好看的嘛，明明可爱的未花就在你眼前！老师，再不理我我可就要捣蛋咯☆」
data.promptProse: Mika props her chin in both hands in the Pater faction parlour, smiling at the teacher's paperwork beyond her teacup. A freshly picked white rose rests beside the cup, her royal gown and white shawl visible around the close frame. Cool side-window light catches rose petals and her pink hair, leaving the velvet chair farther behind and soft hand shadows beneath her cheeks.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 帕特尔派议事厅的小憩
